To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) ELECTRA and RoBerta are good base encoders for different subtasks; (2) knowledge seeking turn and entity detection are helpful for knowledge selection and knowledge usage in generation; (3) latent variable and copy mechanism are effective for response generation; (4) post processing is necessary for final response generation.
we propose to utilize the latent variable to encode dialogue history and selected knowledge, and perform some useful post processing to make further knowledge utilization in the generation task.
we propose a novel model that combines the advantages of both pre trained language model and copy mechanism for task oriented dialogue systems with unstructured knowledge usage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following aspects: 1.
how to make better use of external knowledge for task oriented dialogue systems.
the following three aspects: (1) the knowledge seeking turn detection and knowledge selection subtask; (2) the knowledge grounded response generation subtask; (3) some useful post processing methods.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed system is a strong baseline system with the best performance on the DSTC 9 track 1 dataset.
the proposed system can generate knowledge grounded responses for task oriented dialogue systems with a reasonable performance.
our system can generate knowledge grounded responses with high quality and efficiency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our proposed system is able to retrieve knowledge with entity information and use the retrieved knowledge to generate response with copy mechanism.
our proposed system can generate more knowledge grounded and informative responses than the other systems.
our system is capable to retrieve knowledge from unstructured text, encode knowledge with dialog history, and generate knowledge grounded response.

we can improve the model performance with the help of pre-trained language models.
